title: Step-Aligned Script Generation with Verification and Recovery for Web Automation Testing
title_zh: 面向Web自动化测试的带验证与恢复的步骤对齐脚本生成

paragraphs.en: 总结：TESSARA框架将自然语言测试意图转化为可执行、可重放的Playwright脚本，通过步骤对齐与三级验证实现自动修复。 Automated generation of end-to-end web tests remains costly: developers must identify stable selectors, encode multi-step workflows, attach assertions, and maintain scripts as interfaces evolve. Recent LLM-based web agents can complete natural-language tasks in a live browser session, but task completion is not the same as producing a test-ware artifact - code that is executable, replay-able from a reset state, inspectable by developers, and tied to an oracle. We present TESSARA, an adaptive test-script generation framework that converts natural-language test intent into Playwright scripts consisting of executable interaction code, goal-state assertions, and step-level provenance linking each step to its generated code fragment, selector evidence, execution outcome, and repair history. TESSARA grounds each planned step via Step-Aligned Scripting (SAS), enabling fine-grained failure localization, selective regeneration of failing suffixes, and reversibility-aware backtracking that avoids undoing likely commit points (e.g., form submissions). A three-level verification pipeline (syntactic, execution, and semantic/oracle), detects and repairs malformed code, interaction failures, and incorrect landing states. We evaluate TESSARA on three public web benchmarks, measuring script executability, oracle satisfaction, replay stability, and repair efficiency, and show substantial improvements over baselines and underlying VLMs used directly as script generators.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：TESSARA框架将自然语言测试意图转化为可执行、可重放的Playwright脚本，通过步骤对齐与三级验证实现自动修复。端到端Web测试的自动化生成成本依然高昂：开发者必须识别稳定的选择器、编码多步骤工作流、附加断言，并在界面演变时维护脚本。 近年来基于大语言模型的Web智能体可以在实时浏览器会话中完成自然语言任务，但任务完成并不等同于产出测试资产工件——即可执行、可从重置状态重放、可供开发者检查、并与判定标准绑定的代码。 我们提出TESSARA，一个自适应测试脚本生成框架，它将自然语言测试意图转化为Playwright脚本，该脚本由可执行的交互代码、目标状态断言以及步骤级溯源信息组成，其中每一步都关联到其生成的代码片段、选择器证据、执行结果和修复历史。 TESSARA通过步骤对齐脚本编写（SAS）为每个规划步骤提供依据，从而实现细粒度的失败定位、失败后缀的选择性再生成，以及可逆性感知的回溯，避免撤销可能的提交点（例如表单提交）。 一个三级验证流水线（语法、执行、语义/判定）能够检测并修复格式错误的代码、交互失败以及错误的落地状态。 我们在三个公开Web基准上评估TESSARA，衡量脚本可执行性、判定满足度、重放稳定性和修复效率，结果表明TESSARA相较于基线方法以及直接用作脚本生成器的底层视觉语言模型均有显著提升。
